trace.question:
I haven't made any payment because I need you to tell me which invoice to pay. You asked for Acme Supplies's approved invoice, but Acme (vendor V-628) has two:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-45131 | $6,853.44 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-37191 | $3,551.99 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

The other two Acme invoices can't be paid now. INV-20002 ($8,099.72) is already paid, and INV-78192 ($4,269.77) is still a draft awaiting approval. No payments have been sent from the operating account yet, so nothing has been paid twice.

Should I pay INV-45131 (due first), INV-37191, or both? Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll send it by wire, or by ACH if wire isn't available. I'll pay each invoice exactly once and tell you the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-37191 in full by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-37191, Acme Supplies (V-628), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $3,551.99
- **Status:** Sent

I sent it once, with a unique reference so that a repeat request can't create a second payment. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. Per the payment tool, sending the wire also marks the invoice as paid.

I left INV-45131 ($6,853.44) unpaid because it's under dispute.
